definitions.explanation: A shaking of the ground caused by movement of the Earth's crust. Japan experiences frequent earthquakes.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{地震|じしん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧⟦{国|くに}→国：02204_kuni⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: Japan is a country with many earthquakes.

examples.japanese: ⟦{昨日|きのう}→昨日：00859_kinou⟧⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧{地震|じしん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ありました→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There was a big earthquake yesterday.

examples.japanese: {地震|じしん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{来|き}たら→来る：00254_kuru⟧、⟦テーブル→テーブル：04488_teeburu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{下|した}→下：00670_shita⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{隠|かく}れて→隠れる：02035_kakureru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: If an earthquake comes, hide under a table.

notes:
{地震|じしん} is an important word in Japan, which experiences frequent seismic activity.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {地震|じしん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{起|お}きる→起きる：00521_okiru⟧: an earthquake occurs
- {地震|じしん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{来|く}る→来る：00254_kuru⟧: an earthquake comes
- ⟦{大|おお}{地震|じしん}→大地震：12276_oojishin⟧: major earthquake
- {地震|じしん}⟦{速報|そくほう}→速報：14319_sokuhou⟧: earthquake early warning
- ⟦{震度|しんど}→震度：22807_shindo⟧: seismic intensity

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{津波|つなみ}→津波：05064_tsunami⟧: tsunami
- ⟦{余震|よしん}→余震：16148_yoshin⟧: aftershock
- ⟦{震源|しんげん}→震源：16060_shingen⟧: epicenter
- ⟦{避難|ひなん}→避難：07908_hinan⟧: evacuation

CULTURAL NOTE: Japan has earthquake drills (⟦{防災|ぼうさい}→防災：07907_bousai⟧⟦{訓練|くんれん}→訓練：02673_kunren⟧) regularly, especially on September 1st (Disaster Prevention Day).
